description: Create a new IMAP folder/mailbox. Most servers also create any missing parent folders (e.g. creating "Archives/2026/2026-05" auto-creates "Archives" and "Archives/2026"). Returns success even if the folder already exists.

accountId.description: Account ID (from imap_list_accounts). Optional if accountName is given or only one account is configured.

accountName.description: Account name instead of accountId. Optional if accountId is given or only one account is configured.

folder.description: Full folder path to create (e.g. "Archives/2026/2026-05" or "INBOX.Archive")

name: imap_create_folder
